name: Uberflip
description_en:
Uberflip is a hosted B2B content-experience platform for collecting articles, PDFs and videos into content hubs and curated marketing/sales destinations. Source Streams import or originate content; curated Streams combine existing items for a particular audience. Sales Assist and analytics add their own licensing and setup requirements.

The current site identifies Uberflip as a PathFactory company. That ownership does not make every PathFactory or ChatFactory capability part of an Uberflip subscription. Confirm current product availability, supported components and a written order scope before a new purchase or migration; a live marketing page alone does not establish a roadmap.
description_zh:
Uberflip是B2B托管内容体验平台，将文章、PDF和视频汇集为内容中心及营销/销售目标页。Source Streams负责导入或创建内容，策展Streams为特定受众组合既有条目；Sales Assist及分析还有各自许可和设置要求。

当前官网将Uberflip标为PathFactory公司，但所有权不代表PathFactory或ChatFactory全部能力都进入Uberflip订阅。新购或迁移前需确认当前产品可购性、受支持组件及书面订单范围，营销页仍在线本身不能证明路线图。

core_features.explanation_en: Import one source/type into a Source Stream, then combine selected items in Marketing or Sales Streams.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在来源流导入一种来源/类型，再在营销或销售流组合所选条目。

core_features.explanation_en: RSS/PDF/video sources have source-specific permissions,media limits and sync behavior; formatting is not automatically preserved.
core_features.explanation_zh: RSS/PDF/视频来源各有权限、媒体限制及同步行为，不自动保留全部格式。

core_features.name_zh: 销售资料室及许可分析
core_features.explanation_en: Creating Sales Assist rooms requires a Sales license;analytics access requires a View license as well as permission.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建Sales Assist资料室需Sales许可，分析访问需View许可及权限。

pricing.summary_zh: 设置/订阅/服务依订单报价，未核实当前数字价或免费版；公共2024条款描述预付、60天不续约通知及可能5%续费涨幅，实际订单优先。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Separate imported sources from audience curation
sections.title_zh: 区分导入来源及受众策展
sections.en:
A Source Stream contains a single content type from one source, such as an external blogRSSfeed,aPDFfolder or a video provider. Curated Marketing and Sales Streams select from items already in the hub and mix formats for a target audience. Curating an account-specific experience therefore does not itself import new material.

For an illustrative campaign, import the organization’s blog, add an approved white paper and select a relevant video, then assemble them in a Marketing Stream. A Sales Stream can tailor a destination further for a recipient. Confirm ownership/licensing of every imported item, navigation and the actual public destination. This is an example workflow, not an imported or published campaign.
sections.zh:
来源流只含一种来源的一类内容，例如外部博客RSS、PDF文件夹或视频服务；策展Marketing/Sales流从中心已有条目选择，为目标受众混合格式。因此为某客户策展体验，本身不会导入新资料。

例如活动可导入机构博客、加入获准白皮书并选择相关视频，再组合到Marketing流；Sales流可进一步面向某收件人定制。需确认每条导入资料的使用权、导航及实际公开目标。上述为示例，未导入或发布活动。

sections.title_en: Check the source feed and formatting before expecting a mirror
sections.title_zh: 期待镜像前先检查来源及格式
sections.en:
The import guide requiresAccountAdminorContentManagerand starts in Content > New Stream. ForRSS,a feed may omit older articles or images, so the guide recommends preparing it before import. CSS classes/style/font tags are stripped by default; retaining them requires an option and the corresponding definitions in the hub’s Custom Code. New posts continue to import through the connection, but that does not prove every original layout or asset is reproduced.

The read guide lists default limits including50Vidyardplayers and100most-recentWistiaproject videos. YouTube supports public/unlisted, not private videos. NewSlideShareStreamsare retired. Test initial import,subsequent source updates,media and canonical/SEO behavior with the actual source and version. Broad “all content” language is not a guarantee of unsupported-source ingestion.
sections.zh:
导入指南要求Account Admin或Content Manager，从Content > New Stream开始。RSS可能缺少旧文章或图片，因此指南建议先准备feed。默认剥除CSS class/style/font标签，保留需启用选项并在中心Custom Code中提供相应定义。连接会继续导入新文章，但不能证明原始布局或资产全被复现。

实读指南列默认Vidyard最多50players、Wistia项目最近100视频；YouTube支持公开/未列出视频，不支持私有视频。新建SlideShare流已退役。应以实际来源及版本测试首次导入、后续更新、媒体和canonical/SEO行为，不能将“全部内容”描述当作不支持来源的导入保证。

sections.title_en: Budget creation rights and choose the hub deliberately
sections.title_zh: 预算创建权限，并谨慎选择中心
sections.en:
The Sales Assist guide says anyone can share aDigitalSalesRoom,but creating one requires aSaleslicense. Initial account registration must be done by thePrimaryUser;other administration normally requiresAccountAdministrators. FrontEndV2hubs also need aCompatibilityPackapp. The app creates a special blog stream for seller-created items and asks which hub will hold rooms/templates.

That hub selection cannot be changed afterward in the documented setup, though users can still access content across hubs when composing rooms. Confirm the intended destination and license allocation before registration. A pilot should distinguish sharing an existing room from creating/editing a new one and verify recipient behavior. No app,extension,Outlookadd-in or room was installed or used here.
sections.zh:
Sales Assist指南称任何人可分享Digital Sales Room，但创建需要Sales许可。初始注册必须由Primary User完成，其他管理通常要求Account Administrators；Front End V2中心还需Compatibility Pack。应用为销售创建内容建立特殊博客流，并询问房间/模板存在哪个中心。

文档设置中该中心选择之后不能更改，但用户组合资料室仍可跨中心访问内容。注册前需确认目标及许可分配，试点应区分分享既有房间与创建/编辑新房间，并验证收件人行为。本次未安装或使用应用、扩展、Outlook插件或资料室。

sections.title_en: Read license and freshness rules before interpreting reports
sections.title_zh: 解释报告前先理解许可及新鲜度规则
sections.en:
Analytics requires anUberflipAnalyticsViewlicense;assigning the View permission alone does not grant access. Included license count depends on the pack. CustomExplore reports requireEnterpriseor theAttributionmodule. Scope reporting seats and modules in the order rather than treating analytics as identical for all users.

The guide says collection processing adds roughly1hour of latency. Dashboards can initially show cached data and refresh when newer values differ; reports pull the latest available processed data. Date ranges are start-inclusive/end-exclusive, ending the day before the displayed final date. Those conditions matter when reconciling campaign totals. Exports of report data do not establish a complete site/content backup, and engagement is not by itself proven revenue attribution.
sections.zh:
分析需Uberflip Analytics View许可，单给View权限不授予访问，内含许可数依套餐。自定义Explore报告需Enterprise或Attribution模块，应在订单明确报告席位及模块，不能认为所有用户分析能力相同。

指南称采集处理约延迟1小时；面板初始可能显示缓存，新数据不同才刷新，报告读取最新可用已处理数据。日期范围含起点、不含终点，截止显示结束日期前一天；核对活动总数时这些条件很重要。报告导出不等于完整站点/内容备份，互动也不自动证明收入归因。

sections.title_en: Use the order form for price, renewal and exit scope
sections.title_zh: 用订单确认价格、续费及退出范围
sections.en:
The public Services Agreement read is datedJune4,2024and leaves setup/subscription/professional-service fees to the order form, which takes precedence in a conflict. No current numeric rate or free plan was established. The agreement describes advance billing, generally nonrefundable fees,automatic same-term renewal unless notice is given at least60days before expiry,and a possible increase up to5%per renewal. Confirm the applicable current contract rather than treating an old directory price as a quote.

The agreement reserves the service/platform IP to the vendor and grants subscription access,not ownership of its software. It places customer-data backup responsibility on the customer despite infrastructure backups,and provides for deletion at termination. Retrieve required assets/configuration/analytics before access ends; a complete self-service export or post-termination retrieval window was not verified. These are selected contract observations,not individualized legal advice.
sections.zh:
实读公共服务协议日期为2024年6月4日，设置/订阅/专业服务费用由订单确定，冲突时订单优先。本次未建立当前数字价或免费版。协议描述预付、费用通常不可退、除非到期前至少60天通知否则按相同期限自动续约，以及每次续约可能涨最多5%。应确认实际当前合同，不能将旧目录价当报价。

协议将服务/平台知识产权保留给厂商，只授予订阅访问，不转让软件所有权；即使存在基础设施备份，也将客户数据备份责任放在客户，并规定终止时删除。应在访问结束前取回所需资产/配置/分析，本次未核实完整自助导出或终止后取回窗口。此处为选定合同观察，不是个别法律意见。

sections.title_en: Confirm product continuity without merging parent features
sections.title_zh: 确认产品延续，不能混入母公司功能
sections.en:
The Uberflip homepage identifiesPathFactoryownership,and the parent’s acquisition announcement confirms the relationship while separately describing its own analytics/AIproducts. That is lineage evidence,not proof thatChatFactoryorallPathFactoryfeaturesareavailableinsideUberflip.

The public support policy defines component/versionEOMandEOL,endeavors to give3months’notice beforeEOMand describesEOLtypically3months later. It is a general policy,not a specific whole-platform retirement or support-date notice. Obtain current component support,available subscriptions and any account-specific transition plan directly from the vendor. No such whole-platform date was established by the primary pages read.

Parent evidence: [PathFactory acquisition announcement](https://www.pathfactory.com/blog/pathfactory-uberflip-acquisition/).
sections.zh:
Uberflip首页标PathFactory所有，母公司收购公告确认关系，同时另述其自身分析/AI产品。这是承接关系证据，不证明ChatFactory或PathFactory全部功能在Uberflip内可用。

公共支持政策定义组件/版本EOM及EOL，努力在EOM前3个月通知，并称EOL通常再过3个月；这是一般政策，不是整个平台退役或具体支持日期公告。需向厂商取得当前组件支持、可购订阅及账户迁移计划，实读原始页面未建立整个平台日期。

母公司证据：[PathFactory收购公告](https://www.pathfactory.com/blog/pathfactory-uberflip-acquisition/)。
